The [[Crystal Ettin]] is an [[Ettin]] [[boss]] that appears on the second level of [[Bloodstone Caves]]. It drops the [[Dungeon Key]] for that level. Killing the Crystal Ettin and retrieving an [[Arcane Crystal Shard]] is the goal of [[The Arrow's Point]].
